answer: For agents selling karst maps and jetty surveys, let a trusted network provider issue one anonymous quota credential per paid circuit. Requests expose an epoch nullifier derived from that circuit credential; the ledger pools matching nullifiers under one quota, including requests from mirror accounts. The provider prevents duplicate issuance. Cloning credentials adds no capacity: an attacker must rent extra circuits and pay recurring charges for each additional quota. Honest provider issuance is essential.
